Article dated 2025-07-21. CONFLICT: the Euromonitor-via-Korea-Herald series already on file puts 2025 at KRW 1.16tn, i.e. BELOW this 2024 figure — one of the two vintages is misdated or Euromonitor rebased the category. data_points.source_name: Derived from Euromonitor International via Jangup Shinmun (장업신문)
data_points.methodology: Year-on-year growth computed from the consecutive annual Euromonitor values printed on the fetched page: '한국 남성 화장품 시장 규모가 2020년 1조 640억원에서 2021년 1조 751억원, 2022년 1조 923억원으로 꾸준히 성장하고 있는 것으로 나타났다' — KRW 1.0640tn (2020), KRW 1.0751tn (2021), KRW 1.0923tn (2022). 2022 growth = 1.0923/1.0751-1 = 1.60%; 2021 growth = 1.0751/1.0640-1 = 1.04%. Assumptions: single consistent Euromonitor series, domestic retail sell-through, current prices (not inflation-adjusted; Korean CPI ran well above this in 2022, so REAL growth was negative). Sensitivity: values are given to 4 significant figures so rounding error is negligible (<0.1pp); the main uncertainty is definitional, not arithmetic. Range 1.5-1.7%.
data_points.notes: Article dated 2024-02-06. CROSS-VALIDATION: the 2022 value KRW 1.0923tn matches the KRW 1.09tn (2022) Euromonitor-via-Korea-Herald point already on file, confirming this is the same series and that the derivation is sound. SUBSTANTIVE FINDING: Korean domestic men's cosmetics is growing only ~1-2%/yr in nominal KRW — flat to negative in real terms — which contradicts the 'booming K-male grooming' narrative and sits far below the Future Market Insights 11.04% CAGR (2025-2035) forecast already on file. Growth is on domestic RETAIL, not export FOB and not MFDS production value.
